observations.behavior: Adds a new function partition_measurement_holds, which checks if a recorded measurement is still valid. It checks if the measurement is healthy, if the job that took the measurement completed, and if all subsequent jobs completed with no rows. It also checks if the measurement phase is post_load or if the rows_synced is 0.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks if a recorded measurement is still valid. This could help with performance and reliability, by avoiding unnecessary reads of the table. It could also help with debugging, by providing a clear indication of why a measurement is not valid.

observations.behavior: Adds a new function pre_extraction_measurement_is_redundant, which checks if the pre-extraction activity can skip its read of the Delta log for this run. It checks if the measurement is healthy, if the budget is the same, and if the recent OOM count is below the threshold. It also checks if the earlier jobs are all completed and have no rows.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks if the pre-extraction activity can skip its read of the Delta log for this run. This could help with performance, by avoiding unnecessary reads of the table. It could also help with debugging, by providing a clear indication of why a measurement is not redundant.
